description: The SYP 120 is a fun and innovative balance bike designed for younger riders, perfect for ages 2-5. Combining motocross-inspired plastic styling with triple-clamp forks, this bike offers a thrilling and stylish experience for kids learning to balance and build confidence on two wheels. Available in two vibrant colors, red and pink, the SYP 120 features high-quality components and a durable design, ensuring lasting enjoyment as young riders develop their skills.

components.description: Motocross-inspired plastic triple-clamp forks for enhanced stability and control on the bike.
Tapered handlebars with 19mm handle grips, offering a secure and comfortable riding experience.
Ergonomically designed long integrated saddle for comfort and better control.
Custom-designed tires with aggressive, Knobby tread that provide excellent grip and performance.
Proprietary tires with aggressive, nobby tread, engineered for superior traction on various surfaces.
Plastic faux parts and triple-clamp forks create a thrilling and sporty appearance.
Eye-catching graphics that make the SYP 120 stand out and add to its stylish look.
Equipped with plastic mag wheels, designed for a smooth ride and exceptional durability.
